instructions: 自動保存はReviewCompassでもReviewCompass2でもトライしてきたが，いい方法がない．
approved_direction: do not depend on a session-end hook for correctness
continuously collect available native Codex and Claude logs
recover missed ranges through periodic and startup reconciliation
make raw preservation, cursor movement, deduplication, digest verification, and regeneration deterministic machine operations
treat hooks and file watchers as optional latency optimizations
keep byte-exact raw, private verbatim transcript, and redacted derivatives as separate artifact identities
excluded_scope: implement collector, cursor store, or reconciler
set retention, deletion, encryption, access, or scan interval policies
install or activate scheduler, hook, watcher, or background service
capture or copy current private conversation data
authority_effect: fixes the eventual-preservation design direction and its implementation boundaries; activation and implementation require separate authorization
